result.topic_en: Calculations on the Euler equations of isothermal gas flow (pressure proportional to density, sound speed a), reduced to the spherically symmetric case and transformed into characteristic (Riemann-invariant) form with variables p and q satisfying r' + a log ρ = 4ap and r' − a log ρ = 4aq.

methods.what: Euler momentum equation for isothermal gas (pressure ∝ density, sound speed a)
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}+u\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+v\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+w\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}=-\frac{\partial \log\varrho}{\partial x}a^2$

methods.what: Spherical coordinate line element and velocity components
Radial momentum equation for spherically symmetric flow
Characteristic equations for p and q with geometric source term
Shifted invariants by ±½ log r giving source ±a/(2r)
Variation of p along characteristic dr=(r'+a)dt
Steady flow: constant mass flux and Bernoulli relation, density as function of velocity
Variable s and change of independent variables (r' as variable, hodograph-type)
